thread:
maya: Quick design review — compact invite modal copy feels ambiguous about SSO enforcement. Screenshot attached, but TL;DR users might not know if this is optional or mandatory.

alex: Saw it. Suggest rewording the label + tooltip. Current: `Require SSO` reads like a setting but not action. Ideas: 'Enforce SSO for org' or 'Require SSO for members'.

rui: Heads-up from eng: label changes map to backend flag `sso_enforce`. Renaming is fine but we should keep analytics event names stable or add a shim.

ben: My vote: keep label short on the toggle -> 'Enforce SSO' and use a tooltip for details. Also need an info icon pattern that works on mobile. :thinking_face:

sara: Accessibility nits: toggle contrast fails AA for small text (ratio ~3.0). We need 4.5:1 for body text. Also focus ring disappears when modal backdrop animates — keyboard users lose context.

alex: Good catches. I'll update the color tokens and focus state. Draft microcopy options below:

```
Option A (short): Enforce SSO
Tooltip: Requires all org members to sign in with your SSO provider.

Option B (friendly): Enforce SSO for members
Tooltip: Members must use the organization SSO when signing in. Admins can add exceptions via the Access page.

Option C (explicit): Enforce Single Sign-On (SSO)
Tooltip: All users will be required to authenticate using your configured SSO provider.
```

maya: Option B reads best to me — slightly friendlier and clarifies who is affected. Also one more ask: audit log nav — customers say it takes 3 clicks to filter to 'SSO changes'. Can we add a preset filter or quick action?

rui: We can add a URL preset like `/audit?preset=security-sso` and a quick filter chip on the audit page. Low complexity, small PR.

alex: I'll update the mock with new color swatches and tooltip copy: 'This will require all members to sign in using your org's SSO provider.'

ben: Prefer shorter tooltip in UI: 'Members must use org SSO.' Long form can live in the help bubble or docs.

sara: If tooltip text is shortened, ensure the expanded accessible description exists for screen readers (aria-describedby) and tooltip is >=14px for contrast testing.

alex: Will add `aria-describedby` and a visually-hidden long description node. Also swapping token `accent-200`→`accent-600` for toggle active state to hit contrast.

maya: :thumbsup: Can we get a quick design sanity check by EOD? I'll run a 5-person usability check with two customers tomorrow AM.

deploy-bot: Reminder: schedule staging canary for modal + tooltip changes at 1955509800.

rui: I'll open the PR today and include migration notes for `sso_enforce` rename and the analytics shim. Ping me if wording affects the metrics names.
